in_arabic.name: كاملون
in_arabic.meaning: كاملون يعني المكتمل و الكامل في جميع الصفات الحميدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: كاملون هو اسم مشتق من الكمال و يعني الشخص الذي يتصف بالكمال في جميع الجوانب، سواء كانت صفات أخلاقية أو دينية. وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطيه قيمة دينية و روحية كبيرة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على الشخصية المثالية.

in_urdu.name: کاملون
in_urdu.meaning: کاملون مطلب ہے مکمل شخص جس میں تمام خوبیاں موجود ہوں
in_urdu.long_meaning: کاملون ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے مکمل یا کامل۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ ان شخصیتوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے اخلاق اور دینی معاملات میں مکمل اور بے نقص ہوتی ہیں۔ اس نام کی اصطلاح عربی جڑوں سے نکلی ہے جو کہ قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر کی گئی ہے، جس سے اس کی دینی اہمیت واضع ہوتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: कामिलुन
in_hindi.meaning: कामिलुन का अर्थ है सम्पूर्ण और सर्वगुणसम्पन्न व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: कामिलुन एक इस्लामी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है 'पूर्ण' या 'संपूर्ण'। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो अपने चरित्र और धार्मिकता में पूर्ण होते हैं। यह नाम अरबी मूल से निकला है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी मिलता है, जो इसकी धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्ता को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: کاملون
in_pashto.meaning: کاملون دى داسې سړى مطلب دى چى په ټولو برخو کښى کامل دى
in_pashto.long_meaning: کاملون په اسلامي کلتور کښى يو مهم نوم دى چې د کامل يا مکمل سړى په معنى دی. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې په خپل اخلاق او دينى چارو کښى بې عيب او مکمل وي. دا نوم د عربي ريښو څخه اخستل شوى دى او په قرآن کريم کښى هم ياد شوي دى، چې دى د هغې دينى اهميت ښيي.

in_english.name: Kamilun
in_english.meaning: Kamilun means perfect or complete in all good qualities
in_english.long_meaning: Kamilun is an Islamic name derived from the Arabic root 'kamil', meaning 'perfect' or 'complete'. It refers to an individual who possesses all good qualities and virtues. The name has Quranic origins and is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person of impeccable character and spiritual completeness. Historically, it has been used to denote individuals of high moral and religious standing.

data.cultural_impact: "Kamilun" is a name that evokes a sense of beauty and perfection, both in the physical and moral dimensions of human existence. In Islamic culture, the name Kamilun emphasizes the importance of striving towards perfection in every aspect of life. It highlights the importance of inner beauty and moral character, over external appearances, and is a reminder that true beauty lies in the soul.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Kamilun" holds deep spiritual significance as it represents the ultimate goal of every believer in Islam - to attain nearness to Allah and become a perfect, virtuous, and beautiful individual. It reminds us of Allah's infinite mercy and love, as He is described in the Quran as the Most Merciful, Most Compassionate (Ar-Rahman, Ar-Rahim). By aspiring to be Kamilun, we are also reminded of our eternal purpose and the importance of making every moment of our lives count towards our spiritual growth and salvation. Overall, the name "Kamilun" serves as a powerful reminder of the importance of striving towards spiritual perfection, as well as a source of inspiration and motivation to always strive to be better.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun mentioned a Kamilun ibn al-Hasan in his 'Muqaddimah' as a Berber king of the Banu Ifran in the Maghreb in the 11th century.
historical_references.context: Ibn Khaldun was a prominent historian and sociologist. He wrote 'Muqaddimah', a seminal work in the field of historiography and sociology. In this work, he mentioned a Berber king named Kamilun ibn al-Hasan who ruled the Banu Ifran in the Maghreb.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Kamilun remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Fatima Kamilun in Karachi, Pakistan attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Kamilun, which means "Perfect, Beautiful". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
